calendar.title: Indian Super League 2026-27 kicks off

availability.note: Release calendar (2026-10-10, rights reported): “Indian Super League 2026-27 kicks off” streams on Sony LIV. Sony LIV: streams inside Airtel Xstream Play — Xstream Play plans: ₹99/month ('18 OTTs') and ₹279/month ('24 OTTs'); Xstream Play Premium Pack ₹149/30 days, ₹399/90 days, ₹1,499/365 days.

calendar.detail: Media rights (2026-10-01, 2026–27 Indian Super League): On 1 October 2026, the ISL was reported to have reached an agreement with Sony Sports and Google over the league's media rights for the next two seasons.
